title: Balloon Pop
tagline: Pop smiley, heart, bunny and star balloons over a sunny countryside!
howToPlay: Tap or click a balloon to pop it (or steer the pin with the arrow keys and press Space). Each level brings a new balloon friend: hearts, golden crowns, bunnies, a star that pops every balloon, and a rainbow that makes baby balloons. Tap the sun, a sheep, a house, a tree, the windmill or the hot-air balloon for a surprise. Nothing is ever lost, so take your time.

title: Bumper Ducks
tagline: Bonk, bounce and squeak! Up to 4 rubber ducks in bumper boats grab bubbles and stars.
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle your duck. Tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and BONK! Bubbles are worth 1, stars 3. 🎁 boxes make you giant, super fast or bouncy. Bonk a friend out of the water for a splash bonus. Nobody is ever out!

title: Bunny Hop
tagline: Hop Pip the bunny home through meadows, mushrooms, autumn woods and snow!
howToPlay: Tap the screen or press the space bar to hop. Tap again in the air for a flippy double hop! Munch carrots, hop over logs and pumpkins, and leap for the golden carrots on the way home.

title: Cake Stack
tagline: Stack yummy cake layers into a giant birthday cake for your animal friends!
howToPlay: A cake layer slides back and forth: tap, click or press Space to drop it on the cake. Line it up for a Perfect sparkle, and a wobbly drop just squishes a little. Stack all the layers (or tap the candle button when you are done) and an animal friend comes for a birthday party: tap to help blow out the candles! Every new friend brings a new flavour. Open Recipe studio to build pictured flavour recipes from bottom to top and share equal slices fairly among two or three friends.
learning: Counting, ordered recipes and equal sharing

title: Crash Racers
tagline: Race up to 4 cars through Ubud, Helsinki and Montreal. Crashes welcome!
howToPlay: Steer with the arrows (or ◀ ▶ on a tablet). The car drives itself in Easy gas mode. 🔧 fixes your car, 🔄 puts you back on the road.
learning: Map reading, ordered deliveries and spatial planning

title: Dragon Glide
tagline: Fly Ember the baby dragon through floating sky islands, cloud rings and rainbow waterfalls!
howToPlay: Drag your finger or move the mouse, or use the arrow keys, to fly. Tap, click or press the space bar to puff sparkly fire that pops gem bubbles and lights lanterns. Grab gems, fly through the rings for combos, and catch the rainbow star to zoom. Bumping into things only makes a silly bonk!
learning: Spatial awareness, ring counting and coordination

title: Fish Pond
tagline: Go fishing with Bear and fill your book with fish, a puffer, a whale and treasure!
howToPlay: Pick a place: sunny lake, sunset river, starry night or icy sea. Tap the water (or press Space) to cast. When the bobber dips and a big ! pops up, tap anywhere to reel it in. Missed one? It just swims off giggling and another comes along. Every catch goes into your 📖 book: can you find all 15?

title: Memory Match
tagline: Flip the cards and find the matching animal twins!
howToPlay: Tap a card to flip it and meet the animal inside, then find its twin. Tap 👀 once each round to see a matching pair. Match all the pairs to make the animals dance, and try six levels from 4 to 20 cards.
learning: Visual memory, matching and spatial recall

title: Paint Splash
tagline: Roll giant paint rollers with up to 4 friends and paint a picture together!
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to roll your animal's paint roller. Tap the 🔴🟡🔵 pots to change your paint. Roll a new colour over wet, shiny paint to mix it: red and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make green, red and blue make purple. Grab a 🪣 bucket for a big splash. There is no clock: tap 🖼️ Finished! when your picture is done (and when the playground is nearly all painted, we'll ask), then see the colours you discovered together. It is kept in My pictures by itself. Choose ⏱️ Quick for a 75-second round with 🌈 rainbow and 💧 water puddles. Open Mix my colours to explore the same red/yellow/blue toy paint model in the colour studio.
learning: Colour exploration, creative patterns and cooperation

title: Penguin Bowling
tagline: Belly-slide a chubby penguin down the ice and knock over snowmen and fish!
howToPlay: Swipe up (or pull back and let go) to slide the penguin down the ice. A curvy swipe makes it curve! On a keyboard, ← → aim and Space slides. ◀ ▶ move the penguin. Turn on bumpers 🛟 so every slide reaches the pins. Every roll gets a cheer, and a strike gets fireworks!
learning: Predictions, counting and cause and effect

title: Rocket Garage
tagline: Snap together a silly rocket, then blast your animal pilot off to the Moon and beyond!
howToPlay: Tap or drag parts from the tray to build your rocket: nose cones, windows, fuel tanks, fins, boosters and stickers (tap the rocket to swap a part, tap a colour to paint it). Press the big red button to launch! Drag, or use the arrow keys, to steer and catch stars. Bigger boosters fly farther, and every new planet you visit unlocks new parts. Tap the 🧪 to save rocket A, change one part, and test which rocket flies farther.

title: Star Catcher
tagline: Fly Kitty’s rocket past friendly planets and catch the falling stars!
howToPlay: Drag your finger or mouse, or use the arrow keys, to fly the rocket. Catch stars to travel from planet to planet. Gems are worth 3 and rainbow stars 5; grab a magnet to pull stars in or a heart for double stars. Sleepy space rocks just make you dizzy.
learning: Counting, spatial awareness and star patterns
